pretreatments.description: Mechanical Grinding (In-sink food disposer (Badger 9 model) and manual meat grinder (Grizzly H7778 No 32) with medium and small plate openings, ground separately to simulate different mechanical maceration techniques).

Enzymatic Treatment (Application of excess commercial digestive enzyme formulation (Digest^®, Enzymedica Inc.) containing cellulases, amylases, proteases, and lipases derived from Aspergillus niger and Aspergillus oryzae, applied in excess at a dosage rate of 1 g per 10 g of food waste).
